messages:
maria: kicking off an 'echo testbench' using last week's prod traces. want a quick review of the sampling/anon/determinism plan before i run scale. thinking: stratified sampling by model+seq_len, stable anon map, deterministic replay flag, and kernel-selection parity checks. can we sign off on the protocol?
aj: +1 on stratified sampling. couple q's: how many strata, and what's the target cohort size? also do we keep original timestamps for KV warmup ordering?
maria: good q. plan is ~10 strata: (model, short/med/long), target ~2k requests/stratum. keep relative ordering within traces but randomize inter-trace gaps so load isn't identical to prod. KV warmup: preserve per-session prefix order, but use anonymized session ids.
kevin: anon map approach: deterministic hashing with a rotation salt stored in vault. that lets us reproduce replays while keeping PII out. example: `ANON_ID = sha256(salt + original_id)[:12]`. rotate salt per-quarter.
maria: yep. will add rotation note to the run log. also adding an 'anon-check' pass that verifies no raw email/uuid patterns remain.
aj: determinism: we need to ensure same kernel selection where possible. will add a kernel-override mode: `--force-kernel=baseline` and `--force-kernel=new`. run both across identical sample and diff outputs/token-level timing.
kevin: for KV cache parity, we should compare token-level outputs and also cache hit/miss traces. replay-bot: scheduled replay job created: job_id=rb-2026-04-12-07, config: `--strata=10 --seed=20260412 --anon=sha256 --kv-warmup=preserve`
maria: perf measurement plan: capture p95/p99 latency, token/sec, GPU util, and kernel time breakdown (attention, matmul, softmax). also collect perf counters for kernel flops and memory bw where available. attach perf profiles to job artifacts.
aj: regression criteria: if p99 increases >15% or token/sec drops >12% on new kernel, fail the run and auto-flag for triage. parity tolerance: allow up to 1e-5 logprob drift and up to 0.1% token edits for non-deterministic ops.
kevin: small canary first: run 2 strata with both kernels, check functional parity and perf. if good, scale to full 10 strata. also run a degraded-capacity test (burst + constrained GPUs) to validate graceful fallback.
maria: i'll start the canary in ~30m. FYI the anon-check script is at `infra/replay/tools/anon_sanity.py` — it prints examples and aborts if it finds < 3 anonymized hits.
aj: i'll be around to watch logs. @sre-bot can you create an incident channel if p99 breaches threshold?
sre-bot: will do. alert policy linked: /policies/replay-p99-breach. posting ephemeral heartbeat every 5m during job.
kevin: one more: capture seed + exact binary hashes in artifact metadata so we can reproduce bit-for-bit when investigating parity diffs.
maria: excellent. i'll post the run artifacts link and initial diffs once canary completes. thanks all :rocket:
